title: Your first family conversation
outcome: Greet a relative respectfully, introduce yourself, and ask for repetition.

title: The people who make a home
outcome: Describe people and belongings, explain family relationships, and ask questions.

title: A day in your life
outcome: Talk about routines, ongoing actions, locations, and time.

title: Out in the city
outcome: Order food, buy things, request help politely, and find your way.

title: Tell me what happened
outcome: Narrate completed events and past routines with controlled agreement.

title: Let’s make a plan
outcome: Discuss plans, ability, wishes, and obligations with reasons.

title: What’s on your mind?
outcome: Describe feelings, check on relatives, give advice, and clarify needs.

title: Connect the whole story
outcome: Link events, identify people and things, and explain another person’s message.

title: Say what you really think
outcome: Support an opinion, negotiate, and discuss real and imagined conditions.

title: Find your family’s rhythm
outcome: Interpret aspect and focus, recognize local variation, and select an appropriate register.

title: Keep the conversation going
outcome: Manage calls, service problems, social events, boundaries, and mediation.

title: A seat at every conversation
outcome: Sustain unscripted interaction, understand new stories, and independently expand vocabulary.
